name: kxfeddecision
title: Fed decision in Oct 2026?
settlement: If the Federal Reserve does a Hike of ≥25bps on October 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes for that specific outcome bucket. The outcomes (Hike >25bps, Hike 25bps, Fed maintains rate, Cut >25bps, Cut 25bps) are mutually exclusive; if the scheduled FOMC meeting is canceled, 'Fed maintains rate' resolves Yes and all others No.
decideContext: You are estimating the probability-weighted expectation of the FOMC's October 28, 2026 rate decision (hike >25bps, hike 25bps, hold, cut 25bps, cut >25bps), which determines which single outcome bucket resolves Yes. Judge how news shifts market-implied odds of each specific action versus the others.
